manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top share the same motion afterwards. Acceleration stays at -g even where velocity is zero.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes compare a tossed ball with a ball held by a gate at the apex height. The gate opens at the top. Velocity and acceleration arrows show the readings.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At top jumps to the shared release.
